discovery_notes: All 2019 ArtLand keys already recorded in 208/223 (Aladdin/Tinker Bell 3in round LE 250 Sept 2019, villains LE 250, Pooh, LE 200 and LE 500 Dec 2019, castle jumbo); not re-recorded. 2020 coverage is mainly Disney Pins Blog (owner of DPBStore.com) plus Pulse Gallery listings. Keys omit a retailer slug: releases went to DPBStore.com and other select retailers (not exclusives); retailers recorded as claims. Steamboat Willie LE 125 (2023), Castle series (2021), Swing series (2026) seen and skipped as out of window.
